_about: Which group each device profile belongs to, and the status words. Filled only from what the repository's docs state; each entry names its source. A profile with midi.ports is a controller by RFC 0024, so controllers are grouped from the profile files themselves and only add notes here. A profile not listed here appears under 'Not yet classified' on the page. A `note` is shown beside the status.

instruments.status: Runs today. Oscairn first ran on one on November 12, 2026, as a bundle in a chroot beside the unit's own system; there is no Oscairn image of its own for it.

controllers.status: Controller profile, estimated. Notes, pressure response and PLAY/STOP were confirmed by ear with the desktop app on October 28, 2026.
Controller profile over USB (DAW Remote, Mackie Control port), estimated.

formats.name: CLAP
formats.status: Hosted. Oscairn's own engines and effects are CLAP plugins; the desktop app runs each in a worker process (tested on macOS and in a Linux arm64 VM). Not yet tested in a DAW.
